kv4.2:4.3: hañci saha upapattiyā sotāpanno na hoti. no ca vata re vattabbe:
kv4.2:5.3: hañci saha upapattiyā sakadāgāmī na hotī. no ca vata re vattabbe:
kv4.2:6.3: hañci saha upapattiyā anāgāmī na hoti. no ca vata re vattabbe:
kv4.2:8.1: sāriputto thero na saha upapattiyā arahā’ti.
kv4.2:8.3: hañci sāriputto thero na saha upapattiyā arahā, no ca vata re vattabbe:
kv4.2:9.5: mahāpanthako thero na saha uppattiyā arahā’ti.
kv4.2:9.7: hañci mahāpanthako thero na saha upapattiyā arahā, no ca vata re vattabbe:
kv4.2:10.3: upapattesiyena cittena arahattaṃ sacchikaroti lokiyena sāsavena …pe… saṃkilesiyenā’ti.
kv4.2:11.3: upapattesiyaṃ cittaṃ niyyānikaṃ khayagāmi bodhagāmi apacayagāmi anāsavaṃ …pe…
kv4.2:12.1: nanu upapattesiyaṃ cittaṃ aniyyānikaṃ na khayagāmi na bodhagāmi na apacayagāmi sāsavaṃ …pe…
kv4.2:12.4: hañci upapattesiyaṃ cittaṃ aniyyānikaṃ na khayagāmi na bodhagāmi na apacayagāmi sāsavaṃ …pe… saṃkilesiyaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe:
kv4.2:13.3: upapattesiyena cittena rāgaṃ pajahati, dosaṃ pajahati, mohaṃ pajahati, anottappaṃ pajahatī’ti.
kv4.2:14.3: upapattesiyaṃ cittaṃ maggo …pe… satipaṭṭhānaṃ …pe… sammappadhānaṃ …pe… iddhipādo …pe… indriyaṃ …pe… balaṃ …pe… bojjhaṅgo’ti.
kv4.2:15.3: upapattesiyena cittena dukkhaṃ paṭijānāti, samudayaṃ pajahati, nirodhaṃ sacchikaroti, maggaṃ bhāvetī’ti.
